title: Sealed: 0G, Explained by Story
author: Mumbai prep notes, October 2026
description: Everything about 0G you need before ETHGlobal Mumbai, told through stories you can picture: the dabbawala who carries a sealed tiffin (the router), the kitchen with glass walls (a TEE), the traffic constable who answers in percentages (laya), the library that keeps only fingerprints (0G Storage). Then every team that built on 0G before us, what they used, where they got stuck and what won. Then our own project, a tutor that sees your screen and points, piece by piece: which part of 0G does which job, how the browser version becomes a desktop one, where the seconds go and how to win them back, and the 36 hours, decided in advance. Links to the real docs and pages throughout.
